jet-deau.en: Eaux-Vives puts you on the jetty side of the harbour, useful for returning when the wind settles. Pâquis gives a view across the water and is handier for Cornavin station; allow for crossing the harbour to reach the jetty itself.
jet-deau.zh: 住在活水区，与喷泉栈桥同岸，遇风停喷时方便稍后再来。住帕基区可从对岸欣赏全景，也靠近科尔纳万车站；要走上栈桥，则应另留绕过港湾的时间。

saint-pierre-cathedral.en: A stay in the upper Old Town brings the cathedral close for an early visit, but luggage must travel over slopes and paving. Rive is convenient for trams and buses; the final approach to the cathedral is uphill.
saint-pierre-cathedral.zh: 住在老城高处，清早便能走到圣皮埃尔大教堂，但拖行李要经过斜坡和铺石路。住里夫区方便搭电车及公交，最后去教堂仍需上坡。

reformation-wall.en: Plainpalais is practical for starting at the park gates before visiting the wall. An Old Town base lets you finish beside the cathedral, with a climb back after leaving the Bastions garden.
reformation-wall.zh: 住在普兰帕莱，可从公园入口开始前往宗教改革纪念墙。住老城则可把大教堂放在旅程末尾，从堡垒公园回住处要走上坡。

bastions-park.en: Choose Plainpalais for a level approach to the park and evening transport. Stay in the Old Town for a walk linking the park with the higher streets around the cathedral and Bourg-de-Four.
bastions-park.zh: 住普兰帕莱，到公园的路较平缓，晚间搭车也方便。若住老城，可从花园接着步行上坡，串联教堂和布尔德富尔广场。

bains-des-paquis.en: Pâquis is the convenient base for a morning or evening at the baths, when returning with wet swimwear matters. Eaux-Vives offers a different waterfront walk and a longer return across the harbour.
bains-des-paquis.zh: 若计划早晨或傍晚泡浴场，住帕基区最方便，换下湿泳衣后很快就能回住处。住活水区可多走一段不同的湖滨路线，返程则要绕过港湾。

brunswick-monument.en: The Mont-Blanc waterfront puts the monument on the doorstep and suits early photographs. Cornavin is easier with a rail arrival and luggage, followed by a downhill walk to the lake.
brunswick-monument.zh: 住蒙布朗滨湖一带便于清早来拍纪念碑。若带行李搭火车抵达，科尔纳万车站周边更顺路，再沿下坡步行到湖边。

flower-clock.en: Rive is useful for reaching the garden before busy midday sightseeing. Staying across the lake near Cornavin adds a walk over the Mont-Blanc bridge and makes onward rail travel simpler.
flower-clock.zh: 里夫区适合早点到花钟，避开中午密集的游览人流。住科尔纳万站旁则要走过蒙布朗桥，但方便接续铁路行程。

jardin-anglais.en: Stay by Rive or the left-bank waterfront to reach the garden without crossing the harbour. Pâquis makes a good base for pairing the garden with the baths, using the lake crossing as part of the day’s walk.
jardin-anglais.zh: 住里夫或左岸滨湖区，不必绕过港湾就能到英国花园。住帕基区适合把花园与浴场组合，将跨湖步行本身排为当天路线的一段。

maison-tavel.en: An Old Town room makes the museum easy to pair with the cathedral before or after the visit. Near Bel-Air there are more direct transport connections, followed by a climb through the old streets.
maison-tavel.zh: 住老城方便把塔韦尔故居与大教堂连在一起参观。住贝莱尔站区换车较方便，但前往故居还要沿老街上坡。

museum-art-history.en: Stay around the eastern Old Town for an easy start at the museum and a walk back through Bourg-de-Four. Rive is more practical for public transport, with a climb towards the museum entrance.
museum-art-history.zh: 住老城东侧可一早到艺术与历史博物馆，回程经布尔德富尔广场。里夫区交通更方便，去博物馆入口则要走上一段坡。

natural-history-museum.en: Eaux-Vives works well for combining Malagnou with a lakeside afternoon. Cornavin is convenient for travellers arriving by rail; check current museum access before making the cross-city journey.
natural-history-museum.zh: 住活水区适合上午去马拉纽、下午转湖边。住科尔纳万站旁方便铁路抵达，但专程跨城去自然史博物馆前先核对实际开放情况。

ethnography-museum.en: Plainpalais and the Bains district make it easy to combine the MEG with nearby galleries on foot. Cornavin offers rail connections but adds a journey across the Rhône before the first exhibition.
ethnography-museum.zh: 住普兰帕莱或班区，可步行串联民族志博物馆和附近画廊。科尔纳万站旁方便搭火车，早上看展前需要先过罗讷河。

musee-rath.en: Place de Neuve or Plainpalais is useful for timed exhibitions and an evening performance nearby. Stay near Bel-Air for onward transport and check the museum’s exhibition calendar before arranging the day.
musee-rath.zh: 住新广场或普兰帕莱，便于按场次看展并衔接晚间演出。住贝莱尔便于接续交通，排日程前要看拉特博物馆当期是否有展览。

grand-theatre.en: Prefer Plainpalais or the Old Town if you want to walk home after a late performance at Place de Neuve. Cornavin is convenient for an early train; check the final connection after the advertised curtain time.
grand-theatre.zh: 晚场结束后想步行回住处，可选普兰帕莱或老城。住科尔纳万方便次日赶早班火车，但须按节目预计散场时间查末班接驳。

basilica-notre-dame.en: Cornavin works well for an arrival-day visit: leave luggage at your accommodation before walking to the basilica. Saint-Gervais places you closer to the bridges and old centre if the church is part of a longer walking day.
basilica-notre-dame.zh: 将圣母圣殿放在抵达日时，可住科尔纳万，先寄放行李再步行来访。若以教堂为较长徒步路线的第一站，住圣热尔韦更方便续走河桥和老城。

russian-church.en: The Tranchées side of the Old Town puts the church close for an exterior visit outside services. Eaux-Vives works better for pairing it with the lake; allow for the uphill walk towards the onion domes.
russian-church.zh: 住老城特朗谢一侧，方便在礼拜以外时段观察教堂外观。住活水区更适合兼游湖滨，前往金色洋葱顶时要留出上坡步行时间。

saint-gervais-church.en: A Saint-Gervais base lets you start at the church and continue on foot to the Rhône. Across the river, Bel-Air is useful for exploring the Old Town after the church, with one bridge crossing on the outward leg.
saint-gervais-church.zh: 住圣热尔韦可从教堂出发一路走到罗讷河。住河对岸的贝莱尔方便下午游览老城，早上去教堂时先过一次桥。

parc-la-grange.en: Eaux-Vives is useful for returning from the park on foot after the lakefront walk. The Old Town suits visitors adding museums the next day; allow time to reach an actual park gate rather than the point at the centre of the grounds.
parc-la-grange.zh: 住活水区，走完湖岸后方便步行回住处。若次日安排博物馆，住老城也合适；去公园时按实际开放的园门排行程，别按地图中心点估距离。

ile-rousseau.en: A hotel near the right-bank approach to Pont des Bergues makes the small island easy to revisit in different light. Bel-Air works well on the opposite bank if your next stops are the shopping streets and Old Town.
ile-rousseau.zh: 住贝尔格桥右岸入口附近，方便在不同光线下重访卢梭岛。若下一站是商业街和老城，对岸的贝莱尔更顺路。

patek-philippe-museum.en: Choose the Bains district or Plainpalais to walk between the museum and nearby galleries. Near Cornavin you can leave luggage before a train, but should allow for the return across the river after viewing the collections.
patek-philippe-museum.zh: 住班区或普兰帕莱，钟表博物馆与附近画廊之间可以步行。住科尔纳万站旁方便寄行李赶车，看完馆藏后要把过河回程算进去。

international-reformation-museum.en: Stay in the Old Town to pair the museum with Saint-Pierre in one walk. Below the hill, Rive offers easier transport connections; plan the climb before the entry time for a booked visit.
international-reformation-museum.zh: 住老城可把国际宗教改革博物馆和圣皮埃尔大教堂连成一段步行。坡下的里夫便于换车，预约参观时请把上坡时间算在入场前。

place-du-bourg-de-four.en: In the Old Town, the square can be the start and finish of a cathedral-and-museums walk. Rive makes a more practical base with luggage, especially if you prefer to tackle the uphill lanes without your bags.
place-du-bourg-de-four.zh: 住老城可把布尔德富尔广场设为教堂与博物馆徒步的起终点。带大件行李时里夫更方便，先办好入住，再轻装沿老街上坡。

batie-woods.en: Choose Jonction for the approach near the meeting of the rivers, allowing for the climb into the woods. Plainpalais works if you also want the museum district and can set aside a separate journey to the woodland entrance.
batie-woods.zh: 住容克雄方便从两河汇流附近接近森林，要留出上坡进林的时间。若还要去博物馆区，可住普兰帕莱，另外安排前往林地入口的路程。
